reddit.title: Improved Music Experience in Provincia: Soft Music Reloops
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest improvements to the audio experience in Provincia! The music beds for day, night, title, and combat now feature smooth transitions instead of abrupt cuts. This means no more jarring interruptions during your gameplay. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
